TRANSACTION - FUNCTIONAL DESCRIPTION: Modifies a pricing rule that is being used for payments on EVA platform
EXECUTION FLOWS - DETAILED DESCRIPTION: 1. Input and validations: execute() gets pricingRuleId, pricingRuleRequest and request header USERCODE, then ABKOR001.executePutPricingRules loads the current pricing rule with getPricingRuleById and its active details with getDetailsByRuleId. If no current rule exists, it adds advice ABKO10000405 and returns null. validatePut rejects inactive rules with ABKO10000407, rules outside states PAA, PAU, REJ, SYE or SYC with ABKO10000408, SYC rules with active children with ABKO10000417, start dates before the current date with ABKO10000413, and restricted SYC changes in name, comments, feeType or non-SET details with ABKO10000414. 2. Decisions and branches: executePutPricingRules sets pricingRuleType from the current rule, assigns pricingRuleId to the request DTO, checks duplicate candidates, and branches by status. Duplicate validation rejects unsupported pricingRuleType with ABKO10000416, exact duplicate functional scopes with ABKO10010401, and overlapping variable payment methods with ABKO10010415. If the current status is SYC, handleSycUpdate creates a new version with a new id. Otherwise, it synchronizes inserted and removed details and updates the existing rule. 3. Invoked libraries and methods: execute() invokes ABKOR001.executePutPricingRules. Inside that method the flow calls PricingRuleRepository.getPricingRuleById, getDetailsByRuleId, hasActiveChildren, fillDetailValues, syncDetails, deactivateDetail, getNextId, insertAudit, insertPricingRule and insertDetails, PricingRuleValidator.validatePut, PricingRuleDuplicateValidator.checkIfPricingRuleAlreadyExistsForPut, PutPricingRuleDuplicateValidator.validate, UtilPrDuplicateValidation duplicate comparison helpers, UtilDates.validateActivationDate, PricingRuleMapper.mapRowToDto and mapToInsert, and handleSycUpdate or updatePricingRule depending on status. 4. Errors and subsequent actions: ABKO10000405 is added when getPricingRuleById returns no rule. ABKO10000407, ABKO10000408, ABKO10000417, ABKO10000413, ABKO10000414, ABKO10000416, ABKO10010401, ABKO10010415 and ABKO10010004 are thrown as PricingRuleException and converted into advices with addAdviceWithDescription in executePutPricingRules. ABKO00000010 is raised when deactivateDetail fails to update a removed detail or when updatePricingRule returns 0. After executePutPricingRules returns, execute() calls assignSeverityError and sets Severity.EWR when the advice list is not empty. 5. Outputs and assignment conditions: when the library returns without advices, execute() always calls setPricingruleresponse(pricingRule). The response returns the modified request DTO, with details.value filled by fillDetailValues, status set to PAU on both update branches, precedenceType, progressiveType and comments completed from the existing rule when they were omitted, and id replaced with the new version id only in the SYC branch; if an error occurs, pricingRuleResponse is set with the null returned by the library.
